summary: Regression after Logo + Document Details restructure. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass including new test_articles (asserts 68 Gujarat articles with Affidavit/Divorce/Indemnity Art 4/25/29) and test_order_persists_new_document_fields (purchased_by, description_of_document, article='Affidavit (Art. 4)', consideration_price persist through PUT + GET). Frontend: Galaxy Stamp logo (image /galaxy-stamp-logo.jpg + 'Galaxy Stamp' + 'By DocGalaxy') renders on Home (2 instances = navbar+footer), CustomerLogin (1), AdminLogin (1), Dashboard (2), EStampingForm (2), AdminDashboard (1). Document Details fields verified: field-purchased_by is INPUT, field-description_of_document is TEXTAREA, field-consideration_price strips letters ('abc12.34xyz' -> '12.34'), article-combobox-trigger opens search; typing 'affidav' filters to 2 options and selecting sets trigger text to 'Affidavit (Art. 4)'; typing 'bond' filters to 12 options. Auto-save shows 'Draft saved' and after reload all 4 new values persist. Submit confirm locks the form (readonly-badge visible, purchased_by disabled=true). Admin view-order dialog shows Purchased By / Description of Document / Article / Consideration Price labels and SHCIL Autofill + Copy Code bookmarklet.
critical_code_review_comments: Two seeded Gujarat articles share duplicate 'article' numbers via trailing-space hack ('15 ', '42(b) ', '50 ', '53 ') to differentiate Up-To / Above Rs. 10 Crore variants. Front-end trims whitespace so both tiers display as 'Art. 15', 'Art. 42(b)' etc with identical labels after trim -- consider adding an explicit tier/range field or unique code so users can distinguish them.

Logo component renders Link with data-testid='brand-logo' only when 'to' prop is non-null; on Home/Dashboard/EStampingForm the brand-logo testid is absent (logo is rendered as a non-link inside Navbar). Not a bug but worth standardising the testid so automation can target the logo consistently on every page.
server.py still 379 lines with inline models/routes -- fine for MVP, will benefit from modularisation (routers/auth, routers/orders, routers/admin) as scope grows.
